audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet: Level 1, Level 2 and Level 6 were stored as 'Skill' where the packet has Garen. The page's own whys[] already claimed all three — whys[0] 'You beat a mana-hungry Sylas at level 1', whys[1] 'Level 2 stays yours', whys[4] 'Level 6 your Demacian Justice keeps you ahead'.
audit.why: Sylas pays 55-90 mana per cast with no early sustain outside Kingslayer, which is not yet ranked at level 1. Garen's Q costs nothing and resets an auto. At 6, Garen's execute beats a Hijack that is on an 80-second cooldown at rank 1. Sylas takes over only at two-plus items. Win rate 52.62% over 5768 games.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2 and 6 set to Garen in both layers, proposed as one atomic group with the rest of the chart unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike warned about the stolen ult without giving Hijack's cooldown, and the 3-5 spike was built around silencing an 'E2 chain-strike' that does not exist as described.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30. At rank 1 it is a genuine 80-second commitment, which makes the sequencing rule concrete: if Garen spends Demacian Justice first, Sylas answers with Garen's own execute. By rank 3 it is a 30-second cooldown, which is why the late spike is correct that he scales. The real 3-5 spike is denying Kingslayer.
audit.corrected: Hijack's 80s rank-1 cooldown stated; the 3-5 spike re-keyed to Kingslayer's 12s rank-1 heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] describes Abscond / Abduct as 'His dash + stun (recast pull)'. Riot's text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' There is no stun, and the pull moves SYLAS to the target, not the target to Sylas. The kit carries no hardCC flag on E, consistent with the description. Separately, Kingslayer's heal condition was never stated — Riot: 'dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions' — and the flagged missing interaction for this matchup is exactly the Grievous Wounds requirement.
audit.why: A player told Sylas has a dash-plus-stun will hold Flash and refuse trades that are actually free. What Abscond really does is let him re-enter after disengaging, which is a spacing problem rather than a lockdown problem. And because Kingslayer heals only off champions, minion-adjacent trades give him nothing — while a long duel without Grievous Wounds gives him everything. Petricite Burst is the third unstated piece: after any cast his next attack whirls chains for bonus magic damage, so stepping in immediately after he casts is stepping into extra damage, not into a gap.
audit.corrected: Abscond restated as a dash with a self-pull recast and no stun; Kingslayer's champion-only heal and the anti-heal requirement stated; Petricite Burst named in the mistakes list.

audit.whatIsWrong: All-in window keyed only to the dash cooldown.
audit.why: Abscond at 13s rank 1 stops him escaping, but Kingslayer at 12s rank 1 is what lets him survive the trade he cannot escape. Both have to be down.
audit.corrected: Commit condition now requires both spent.

edits.after: Abscond (13s at rank 1) is a dash, and the recast pulls Sylas to you rather than pulling you to him — it never stuns, so bait it and commit.

notes: The load-bearing error here was calling Abscond / Abduct a 'dash + stun'. Riot's text gives Sylas a dash whose recast pulls HIM to an enemy — no stun, and no hardCC flag in the kit to suggest otherwise. That claim appeared in the key-interactions field, which is the one a player reads before deciding whether a trade is safe. Also added the flagged missing anti-heal interaction (Kingslayer heals only against champions) and Hijack's real 80s rank-1 cooldown. Mirror sylas__garen not yet audited; it must show Sylas losing Levels 1-6 with inverse ratings.
